<!-- B"H

# Chesed — Every Possible Final Verification

The mission is larger than “does the page load.” Every layer that can change the generated request must be witnessed.

Possible proof surfaces:
- Current-production ancestry and exact Better V2 path preservation.
- Public five-suite browser regression on current production.
- Status route and provider-readiness truth.
- Browser proxy exact HTTP methods, paths, encoding, request bodies, and error parsing.
- Server route exact status/create/task dispatch.
- MiniMax upstream URL, bearer header, content type, create/query methods.
- Text-only mapping and concrete aspect ratio.
- First-frame, last-frame, and first+last role mapping.
- Reference image/video/audio role mapping and ordering.
- Illegal mixed frame/reference rejection.
- Asset replacement retaining stable reusable id while replacing blob/signature/metadata.
- Preview URL cache invalidating when `updatedAt` changes.
- Draft assignments automatically observing replaced asset through stable id.
- Transport producing the new replacement bytes exactly once.
- Remove/reorder behavior not resurrecting stale media.
- Browser UI replacement preserving prompt/mode/focus.
- Browser network remaining free of provider secret leakage.
- Missing provider credential returning deterministic non-success, never fake generation.
- Task polling and completed output URL extraction.
- History/cache policy around successful outputs.
- Production Git/service/public static proof.
- Cleanup of owned release/test processes and worktrees.

No paid upstream success can be invented while production MiniMax is `configured:false`.
